title: FreightWaves What the Truck?!?: Beyond Manual Dispatch & Predictive Safety | WHAT THE TRUCK?!?
summary: FreightWaves’ WHAT THE TRUCK?!? podcast speaks with Descartes’ Hayden Cardiff, VP of Safety Solutions, about why regulatory compliance alone isn't enough to keep fleets safe. Hayden explores how AI-powered predictive safety helps fleets identify driver risk before accidents occur, uncover leading indicators of unsafe behavior and deliver targeted coaching to improve safety outcomes.
body_markdown:
FreightWaves’ WHAT THE TRUCK?!? podcast speaks with Descartes’ Hayden Cardiff, VP of Safety Solutions, about why regulatory compliance alone isn't enough to keep fleets safe. Hayden explores how AI-powered predictive safety helps fleets identify driver risk before accidents occur, uncover leading indicators of unsafe behavior and deliver targeted coaching to improve safety outcomes.
